decision: Accept the bounded architecture for a separate root-owned public representation publication. This is not consumer implementation admission or G8.4/G7.3 completion.

resolved_findings.issue: Proposed C PollDrain Bool exceeded current C ABI profile.
resolved_findings.resolution: Frozen proposal uses i32: 0 Pending, 1 complete no-future, every other value fixed fault/abort without reclamation. Source close returns canonical ordinary Poll<Unit>.

resolved_findings.issue: active=0, Closing or callback quiescence cannot establish complete raw-record no-future.
resolved_findings.resolution: Provider 1 explicitly covers queued/pre-trampoline and rejected raw entries plus all backend userdata accesses. Record/environment remain live while any condition is unresolved.

resolved_findings.issue: Async constructor failure can strand a published userdata root.
resolved_findings.resolution: Nullable install failure is allowed only after synchronous withdrawal/quiescence of every raw/backend user. No discarded Closing owner on the error path.

resolved_findings.issue: Current Task Poll<Unit> does not refine the same owner to Closed statically.
resolved_findings.resolution: Proposal now explicitly distinguishes reusable Poll transport from a missing owner-state relation; explicit finish preserves actual runtime CLOSED guard. Unknown pollable Direct automatic Drop is statically rejected.

resolved_findings.issue: ClosedEnvironment alone does not prove synchronous environment teardown.
resolved_findings.resolution: First-slice actual callback and complete cleanup graphs must be independently Direct/synchronous; no borrowed environment, cross-thread Transfer/Share or async nested cleanup is inferred.

current_source_facts.finding: FinishDestroy checks owning carrier and consumes the actual responsibility. No existing Poll.Ready-to-owner Closed fact is established here.

Actual state==3 dominates free; otherwise task.trap. Existing explicit early-destroy contract says trap without free, with native test expecting failure and allocation-only output A, not F. This historical source inspection is not a fresh replay.

Design forbids free before Closed and automatic Drop suspension; it does not require every explicit early-finish call to fail at compile time. Runtime guard for explicit finish is consistent with the existing Task contract. A future statically Closed automatic Drop permission needs a new independent private relation.

Present actual worker/teardown graph establishes only closed synchronous cleanup. AsyncRegistration needs new independently reconstructed pollable-owner debt/drain recipes, not a new accepted synchronous DropPlan leaf.

minimum_publishable_scope.carrier: Distinct sealed AsyncRegistration<actual concrete F>, legal Managed/Desc/exact exclusive complete head. No Copy/borrow/dyn/Transfer/Share/cross-thread qualification.
operations: unsafe c_register_async(register,request_close,poll_drain,f): nullable owning carrier; actual source-order consumption
finish_destroy(give owning head)->Unit with mandatory actual CLOSED guard
minimum_publishable_scope.callback: Same-thread concrete Direct FnMut(i32)->i32 + independently checked ClosedEnvironment; owned mutable local state is valid. Actual cleanup graph synchronous; fixed existing abort policy, no unwind/longjmp/Suspend across FFI.
minimum_publishable_scope.empty_head: valid false; request no-op; poll_close Ready(Unit); finish no-op. No non-null incomplete carrier may take this path.
minimum_publishable_scope.pending_exit: Private Task reason/result-live/closing-PC and canonical actual obligations; no new public PendingExit payload or transported settled/noExternal proof bit.
minimum_publishable_scope.direct_drop: No first-slice automatic Drop recipe for an unknown pollable carrier. Explicit advancing owner/root and explicit finish required.
minimum_publishable_scope.compatibility: Existing synchronous Registration, TaskI32/SABI1 and ordinary enum authority remain unchanged.

implementation_work_not_provided_by_publ: Types/Analyze and Verify each reconstruct real provider roles/unsafe origin, canonical full F, concrete capture and cleanup graph, unique actual root and exclusive windows.
Each kernel independently rejects unfinished pollable roots at Direct scope exit/normal/error branches; merely invoking poll_close or constructing ordinary Ready is not a discharge fact.

Private verified Task owner/drain recipe retains registration, parent/child/input and PendingExit result obligations across real Pending; notify actual live children/roots before ordered drain, preserve body-error priority and original cleanup ordering.

Native stable record/trampoline remains allocated through rejected late entries and backend no-future; runtime CLOSED gate dominates free and repeated request/close/finish preserves once-only effects.

Real host queue pending-to-drained source/native tests, allocation/install failure, reentry, invalid provider tags, normal/error/cancel result ownership and raw/Wire negatives are still required. A false wrapper around synchronous close does not demonstrate async drain.
All new complete types/role IDs/operands and actual cleanup/layout identity enter bounded codec/fingerprint/CGU/cache work; actual consumer budgets remain prepaid.
nonblocking_editorial_note: Frozen nearest-cases phrase mutable or borrowed callback environment is ambiguous. Author acknowledged and will change it to retained shared/mutable captured borrow; owned mutable FnMut state remains a positive case.
validation: Read-only normative/source/proposal review. No new implementation build, test, runtime ABI validation or full test run performed for this interface review.
